messages:
tariq: FYI we're getting a weird cluster of fncall validation errors on the payments->v2 route in eu-west canary. Reject rate jumped from 0.02% to 1.1%. anyone on call?

neha: saw the spike at 09:02. quick grep shows payloads where `line_items` is `null` instead of an empty array. adapter v1 returns null for empty carts.

rowan: hmm that's a schema mismatch we used to tolerate. Canary is running `validation=strict` so these become hard rejects and flood the dashboard.

cass: can we differentiate between "structurally wrong" vs "nullable/coercible" failures? UX for SREs would be so much better if we can filter those.

ops-bot: Alert: [fncall] REJECT_RATE_HIGH route=payments/v2 env=eu-west window=4m rejects=1290 baseline=15

tariq: example log: ```[fncall] VALIDATION_ERROR path=line_items expected=array got=null req=tx-77a5```

neha: quick mitigation: rolling the canary to permissive validation reduces alerts but hides real regressions. not ideal.

rowan: proposal: introduce `coerce_nullable` validation mode. Behavior: on known nullable fields (config list), coerce `null`->`[]` or `''`, emit telemetry tag `fncall.coerced=true`, and optionally write a sampled audit event.

cass: important: two separate metrics: `fncall.rejects` (strict) and `fncall.coerced` (coercions). Console charts should show both and allow toggling whether `coerced` contributes to the reject line.

neha: billing concern: current quota/accounting uses `fncall.rejects` to trigger rate-limits. If we move to coercion we must decide if coerced responses consume quota. Ops wants transparency so they can bill for problematic clients.

rowan: compromise: coerced responses are not treated as billing rejects by default, but we add a derived metric `fncall.coerced_billed` that ops can enable per-tenant. Toggle lives in Dedicated/Private config.

cass: console work: add a small "validation ribbon" on route detail page showing current mode (strict|permissive|coerce) and a mini histogram of top fields coerced in the last 24h. link to first sampled payload.

tariq: sampling rules: emit a sampled audit event for 0.2% of coerced responses. store encrypted blob + minimal headers. retention 7d by default. Security sign-off needed.

sec-bot: Policy: any retained payloads must be scrubbed and encrypted with customer-managed KMS when customer data is present. File ticket for compliance review.

neha: noted. we'll add automatic scrubbing: email/ccn/ssn detection and mask before encryption.

rowan: telemetry plan: add counters `fncall.coerced.count`, `fncall.coerced.sampled.count`, tag `validation.mode=coerce|strict|permissive`, and record top-field histogram. Also emit event `fncall.coerce_spike` when rate > configured threshold.

cass: UX followups: a Rollouts page control to set validation.mode per-slice. Default: prod=strict, canary=coerce. Also add a one-click "promote strict" to flip modes when rollouts pass.

ci-bot: CI: created branch `eng/validation-coerce` and added unit tests for coercion logic. draft PR awaiting review.

tariq: Ops: please add spike alert for `fncall.coerced.count` with a lower severity but paging on sustained high volume. We don't want pages for small noise but we do want heads-up for surges.

neha: will do. also adding a console toggle to overlay coerced events on the reject heatmap so SEs can correlate with deploys.

rowan: one more thought: we should surface the commit or adapter id that caused the coercion spike in the console so teams can triage quickly. include `adapter.version` in telemetry.

cass: great. UI will show top 3 adapters by coercion rate and a link to sample payloads.

sec-bot: Compliance reminder: redact PII and include audit log recording who accessed sample payloads. Access requires elevated role.

tariq: next steps: neha implements coercion list + scrubbing, rowan wires metrics and spike event, cass/ux add console ribbon and toggle, ops create alert. We'll coordinate on the PR.

rowan: adding a short doc in the infra repo describing the `coerce_nullable` contract and recommended default lists per tool.

cass: thanks all. if anyone needs to revert the canary to strict quickly, ping `#release-war-room` and include `validation=mode` in the message.

neha: patch pushed to branch, running integration tests now. will update PR link here when ready.

ci-bot: Integration tests passed for `eng/validation-coerce`. PR: https://github.com/rwd/infra/pull/4142

tariq: lovely. let's keep the sampling low for first 48h and monitor. I'll post follow-ups in the RFC thread."
